parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper blade and handle set of the scissors, made of stainless steel, forming one half of the cutting mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It provides one of the cutting edges and a handle loop for finger placement, allowing the user to apply force for cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw pivot relative to the lower blade handle set to perform the cutting motion.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower blade and handle set of the scissors, made of stainless steel, forming the second half of the cutting mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the opposing cutting edge and a handle loop for thumb placement, working together with the upper blade to cut materials.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw pivot relative to the upper blade handle set to create the shearing action.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: This is the central screw that connects the two blade handle sets, made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the pivot point, holding the two blades together while allowing them to rotate smoothly for cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to the blades, serving as the rotational axis for their movement.
